title: Create Synthetic Browser Monitor
description: Workflow that provisions a Dynatrace synthetic browser monitor via the Synthetic Monitors API (v1). Reads monitor configuration from workflow parameters and posts to the tenant REST endpoint. On success the entityId is logged; on failure a descriptive error is surfaced.

monitorName.description: Display name of the synthetic browser monitor. Override this variable before running the workflow to change the monitor name without touching execution parameters.

validate_inputs.name: validate_inputs
validate_inputs.description: Validate that required workflow parameters are present before attempting monitor creation.

build_monitor_payload.name: build_monitor_payload
build_monitor_payload.description: Construct the JSON request body for the Dynatrace Synthetic Monitors API.

create_synthetic_monitor.name: create_synthetic_monitor
create_synthetic_monitor.description: POST the monitor payload to POST /api/v1/synthetic/monitors. Returns entityId on success.

verify_and_log_result.name: verify_and_log_result
verify_and_log_result.description: Check the HTTP response status code and extract the new monitor entityId.

handle_error.name: handle_error
handle_error.description: Runs if any upstream task fails. Surfaces the error message for operator review.
